verdict.rationale: Sardine is an API-driven fraud and compliance SaaS platform, so issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack only covers sandbox dashboard access, email invitations for dashboard users, and protected API documentation. Nothing documents API key issuance, permission scoping, or agent-specific credentials, and dashboard user invites are an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
